## Seoul Weekend Plan for 3 Adults, 2026-05-15 to 2026-05-17
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg

A compact 3-day plan centered on K-pop spots, one market visit, easy subway access, and moderate walking only. I’m assuming you want a comfortable, transit-first trip with a few paid experiences but no heavy nightlife or long cross-city transfers.

## Best District to Stay In: Myeongdong
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg

**Best fit: Myeongdong** for this trip.
- Excellent subway access on Lines 2 and 4, plus easy airport connection options
- Close to N Seoul Tower, Namdaemun Market, Hongdae via subway, and central transfer points
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/Adnan_Kebab._Iraqi_Kebab_Restaurant._Namdaemun_Market_Seoul%2C_South_Korea_01.jpg Alt=Close to N Seoul Tower, Namdaemun Market, Hongdae via subway, and central transfer points, Seoul, South Korea
- Plenty of hotels in the mid-range budget band for 3 adults

**Good alternatives**
- **Hongdae**: best if you want more youth culture and K-pop vibes at night
- **Jongno/City Hall**: best if you want a more traditional, central base near palaces and markets

## 3-Day Seoul Itinerary with Budget Estimate
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg

### Day 1: Myeongdong + K-pop shopping + N Seoul Tower area
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/music-note.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and do an easy Myeongdong walk for cosmetics, K-pop merch, and snack stops
- Afternoon: Visit a K-pop retail area such as **Myeongdong Underground Shopping Center** or nearby music stores; keep the schedule light and subway-based
- Evening: Go to **N Seoul Tower** area for skyline views; use the cable car or taxi for the steepest part to reduce walking
- Food: Korean BBQ or bibimbap near Myeongdong, with a simple dessert stop

### Day 2: Hongdae K-pop culture + one traditional market
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- Morning: Head to **Hongdae** for K-pop street energy, idol-themed shops, and casual cafe stops
- Afternoon: Visit **Namdaemun Market** as your traditional market day; keep it focused on souvenirs, street snacks, and easy browsing
- Evening: Return to Hongdae for a relaxed dinner and optional busker-street atmosphere
- Food: Market snacks at Namdaemun, then noodles or fried chicken in Hongdae

### Day 3: COEX / Starfield + light finale
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Visit **COEX Mall** for a comfortable indoor stop with subway access, shopping, and K-pop-adjacent retail
- Afternoon: Add **Starfield Library** and nearby Gangnam-area browsing without much walking
- Evening: Finish with a simple farewell dinner near your hotel or at a station-connected mall
- Food: Casual Korean set meal or café lunch in COEX

## Cost Estimate for 3 Adults
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/currency-rupee.svg

| Category | Estimated Cost (KRW) | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Hotel, 2 nights | 300,000–420,000 | Mid-range business hotel in Myeongdong/Jongno |
| Local transport | 45,000–75,000 | Subway, airport transfer, and one short taxi ride |
| Food and drinks | 180,000–240,000 | 3 adults, mixed casual meals + snacks |
| K-pop shopping / merch | 120,000–180,000 | Depends on how much merch you buy |
| Entry fees / paid activities | 60,000–120,000 | Tower, cable car, exhibits, optional extras |
| Market purchases | 30,000–60,000 | Snacks and souvenirs |
| Buffer | 50,000–80,000 | Small overruns and convenience purchases |

**Estimated total:** **KRW 785,000–1,175,000**

**Budget fit:** Your target of **KRW 900,000** is workable if you:
- choose a moderate hotel around **KRW 150,000–190,000 per night**
- keep shopping controlled
- use subway for most moves and limit taxis to one or two short rides
